scope: Commit/Rebase legacy message-file encoding and explicit UTF-8 metadata transport. Partial parity; full application port remains incomplete.

verification.core: 177 affected CommitMessage, CommitSelection, CommitAmend, CommitHistory, GitBlame, Rebase, RevisionComparison, SubmoduleComparison and SubmoduleConflict tests passed. Fixed Windows-1252/ISO-8859-1/CP1251/Shift-JIS byte vectors, source first-duplicate/fallback behavior, replacement and unsupported codec, private 0700/0600 file cleanup, and actual legacy Rebase Edit/Squash continuation verified. Separate source audit confirms all 156 ordered alias pairs exactly match the pinned upstream file.
verification.native: Final headless receiver passed system Git and Git 2.37.1, 2.39.5 and bundled 2.55.0. Actual native Commit model commits verify five raw cat-file byte vectors and retained Unicode history; full-index native commit and separate-index core amendment verify alternate transports. Unsupported UTF-16 encoding leaves HEAD/index untouched and creates no requested branch. Native Rebase model reads exact decoded legacy pause file and continues a real edit with expected encoded body. No physical UI or screenshot acceptance claimed.
verification.initial_failures: The first encoding-file transport lacked ordinary -m final-LF behavior; adding it unconditionally then introduced an extra LF for three existing verbatim squash date-policy assertions. Corrected by retaining ordinary final-LF behavior and preserving exact supplied raw squash endings; final affected core run passed. First native matrix expected one LF in paused rebase message; Git 2.37.1/2.39.5 produce two. Independent probe confirmed Git behavior; receiver now compares the exact decoded file, with unchanged production logic, and all four versions passed.
verification.builds: Unsigned Debug and AppStore builds passed, both exact bundled NOTICE comparisons and bundle audits passed, including all 96 original icon resources. Store --require-git audited 11 universal Git Mach-O files and fixture operations; EditorConfig and IssueRegex audits passed.
verification.documentation: Commit parity and upstream file inventory updated; local site generated, unpublished.
verification.ci: Native receiver added to macOS workflow. Hosted CI/push/site publication unverified; no authentication retry.
verification.processes: All compiler/test/receiver sessions terminal. No main GUI launch or displayed windows. Final main-app/receiver audit empty. Five empty owned preference files removed; the initial crashed receiver domain was identified by its temporary fixture history and explicitly cleared. Other preferences retained.
verification.limitations: Exact Windows best-fit/default-byte behavior, all uncommon/stateful codecs, externally started or encoding-changed Rebase sessions, mixed-encoding author headers and RefLog subjects, legacy templates and other message-file callers remain pending. Physical UI/keyboard/VoiceOver, signed sandbox execution, full dialog/application parity, Finder activation, screenshots/manual, signed distribution/App Store and hosted publication remain incomplete.
